duration.value: until the end of the target's next turn

description.value:
You manipulate the connection between your pawn and its victim, compelling the target to take the actions you choose on its turn as though it were a puppet itself. The target can't Delay or use reactions until it has obeyed your commands; afterward, it can use its remaining actions as normal. You can compel the target to take only actions you know it's capable of, and you can't compel it to cast a spell that isn't on a spell list from which you can Cast a Spell. Compelling the target to harm itself disrupts your connection, immediately ending this spell and the target's fatebound condition. The effects of this spell depend on the target's Will save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target takes one action of your choice.

Critical Failure The target takes two actions of your choice. These can be a single two-action activity.
